# Fixture advisory with a CVSS v4.0 vector

A FIXTURE advisory (s8c §8c.4; D21-63), not a real one. It matches `itoa 1.0.18` in
`../advisory-db/project/Cargo.lock`. Its vector is CVE-2025-47273's CVSS v4.0 vector, as the `cvss`
2.2.0 crate's own regression test carries it (base score 7.7). The in-tree scorer scores v3 only, so
a scan that matches this advisory refuses by name (`cvss-unscorable`), never counting it `unrated`.

*(dated 2026-09-26, s8c build, CVSS; D21-64 ruling 7.)* ~~refuses by name~~ no longer: the adapter scores
a `CVSS:4.0` vector with the `cvss` 2.2.0 crate's v4 scorer, so a scan that matches this advisory counts
it `high` (`verbs::a_matched_v4_vector_is_scored_and_banded_high`). The 7.7 is the crate's score of the
vector as written, CVSS-BT under FIRST v4.0's nomenclature because it carries `E:P`; the same vector
without threat metrics scores 8.7 (CVSS-B), also `high` [measured 2026-09-26 in the test binary].

*(dated 2026-09-26, s8c build, D67; D21-67 ruling 7.)* The adapter now scores base-only (CVSS-B), so
this advisory's score is 8.7, still `high`
(`verbs::a_v4_vector_is_scored_base_only_so_no_other_metric_moves_its_band`).
